verdict_reason: The promoted request helpers and AddressBody work correctly, but the sample address is duplicated from AddressTestSupport and the caller-variant helpers and the mapper constant are misnamed.

todos.issue: The sample address is written twice: IntegrationBase.java:65-71 (NAME, ADDRESS_LINE_1, TOWN_OR_CITY, POSTCODE, COUNTRY_CODE, PHONE, EMAIL) and the AddressBody defaults at :262-270 (including roles PLACE_OF_ORIGIN) repeat the same literals as AddressTestSupport.validRequest() (address/AddressTestSupport.java:21-29), which this file already imports NO_LIST_CRITERIA from. A change to the valid request body (e.g. a newly required field) must be made in both places.
todos.fix: Must: one test-support owner holds the valid sample address values and default roles; IntegrationBase's constants and AddressBody defaults read from it. One way: make the sample values public constants on AddressTestSupport (or have AddressBody start from AddressTestSupport.validRequest() serialised to a map) and delete the copies here.

todos.issue: The request-as-another-caller helpers are named two ways: listAddressesAs (:186), getAddressAs (:208) and deleteAddressAs (:218) carry an 'As' suffix for the (orgId, callerOrganisationId, ...) form, while the same form for create and update is an unmarked overload, postAddress(orgId, callerOrganisationId, body) (:147) and putAddress(orgId, callerOrganisationId, addressId, body) (:163). A reader of postAddress(ORG_B, ORG_B, body) in AddressScopingIT cannot tell from the name that the caller header differs from the default, while getAddressAs says so.
todos.fix: Must: one naming scheme for every helper that takes a path organisation and a caller organisation, applied to post, put, get, list and delete alike. One way: rename the overloads to postAddressAs and putAddressAs (keeping the default-caller postAddress/putAddress), and update their callers.

todos.issue: The constant JSON (:57) holds an ObjectMapper, not a JSON value; its call sites JSON.readTree(body) (readIds) and JSON.writeValueAsString(fields) (AddressBody.json) read as though JSON were the document. Beside AddressBody.json(), which does return JSON text, the same word names both a mapper and a string.
todos.fix: Must: the mapper's name says it is a mapper. One way: rename it OBJECT_MAPPER (or JSON_MAPPER).
